aboutLead: I’m Abdulmajid Abdurrahim, a software engineer, product designer, and project professional based in Doha, Qatar. My work connects user needs, business goals, and technical delivery—from shaping user journeys and interfaces to building applications and coordinating the work that brings them to life. I work across React, Next.js, TypeScript, back-end integrations, and workplace IT, with experience spanning creative studios, technology products, energy, and operations.
toolkitDescription: From web and mobile interface design to working products: reusable components, state management, API integration, and responsive styling.
aboutStory: Being a father has made me more intentional about what I build and the impact it has on people. I bring that same care to product and brand design, product engineering, motion design, and video editing, while managing projects across IT, creative, construction, and operations.
